Diet diaries were collected in years 1950, 1982, 1989, 1999 and 2006-10. The diary in 1950 was a one day recall. Diaries in 1982 and 1989 were for a two day recall followed by a 5 day prospective. Diaries in 1999 and 2006-10 were for a 5 day prospective.
